title: Goliash
description: What runs where, drift, services behind upstream, delivery speed, image hygiene and the health of Goliash itself, from Goliash /metrics.

widgets.title: Behind upstream
widgets.description: Service × environment pairs behind the newest release by at least the tracked jump (sum of goliash_outdated).

widgets.title: Open drifts
widgets.description: Open environment, upstream and inconsistent drift.

widgets.title: Oldest drift (days)
widgets.description: Days the oldest open drift has lasted.

widgets.title: Running versions
widgets.description: Distinct service, environment and version combinations running.

widgets.title: What runs where
widgets.description: Running replicas per service, environment and version.

widgets.title: Open drift
widgets.description: Open drift by service, environment and kind, in days.

widgets.title: Behind upstream by environment
widgets.description: How many services each environment runs behind upstream.

widgets.title: Longest drift per service
widgets.description: Days the longest open drift of each service has lasted.

widgets.title: Deploys (30 days)
widgets.description: Versions that arrived in the selected environments in the last 30 days.

widgets.title: Median lead time
widgets.description: Median of the services' median time from one environment to the next, last 30 days.

widgets.title: Slowest promotion
widgets.description: The longest median lead time of any service and environment pair.

widgets.title: Hygiene findings
widgets.description: Images with a moving tag, a tag pushed again, an untrusted registry or no digest.

widgets.title: Deploys per service
widgets.description: Versions that arrived in the last 30 days, per service.

widgets.title: Lead time
widgets.description: Median time a version took from one environment to the next, last 30 days.

widgets.title: Agents
widgets.description: Agents by status: online, stale (stopped reporting), never connected, revoked.

widgets.title: Snapshots pending
widgets.description: Snapshots received and not processed yet; a growing number means the server falls behind.

widgets.title: Notifications failing
widgets.description: Notifications not sent that failed at least once.

widgets.title: Servers running background work
widgets.description: Must be exactly 1 across all servers sharing a database.
